column3: “Before the mountains” renders conducting a case with the mountains as pleading before them.
“Remember your journey” is supplied before “from Shittim to Gilgal”.
“Ten thousand” is singular where the Hebrew has plural tens of thousands.
“Can I forget” replaces the question about whether these things are still there.
“Excuse” renders being clean as excusing the scales; “bags” is plural instead of singular.
“Nations” replaces “My people” in the final phrase.
